St Pete Beach Jet Ski Rental (Guided Tours & Island Adventures)

Looking for the best St Pete Beach jet ski rental?
Welcome to Xtreme Jetski Watersports, where we deliver premium guided jet ski experiences just minutes from St Pete Beach.

Whether you're visiting for vacation or you're a local looking for an unforgettable day on the water, our tours take you beyond the beach and into Florida’s most beautiful coastal destinations.

Why We’re the Top Jet Ski Rental Near St Pete Beach

We’re not just a rental — we’re a guided experience company focused on safety, fun, and unforgettable moments.

  • ⭐ 5-Star Rated by Hundreds of Riders
  • 🛥️ Premium Yamaha WaveRunners (Fast, Stable, Reliable)
  • 🧭 Guided Tours — No Guesswork, No Stress
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Beginner-Friendly (No Experience Needed)
  • 📍 Located Minutes from St Pete Beach

You won’t be stuck in a small riding zone — we take you out to explore.

Ride Beyond St Pete Beach – Explore Real Florida

When you ride with us, you’ll experience more than just open water.

🌴 Egmont Key Island

Crystal-clear water, historic ruins, and one of the most unique stops in Tampa Bay.

🐚 Shell Key Preserve

A hidden gem known for shelling, wildlife, and untouched beaches.

🌊 Fort De Soto Area

Perfect riding conditions with wide-open water and incredible views.

🐬 Dolphin Encounters

Dolphins regularly swim alongside our tours — a highlight for most riders.

Guided Jet Ski Tours (Perfect for Beginners)

Never ridden before? No problem.

Our guided tours are designed to make your experience:
✔️ Safe
✔️ Easy to learn
✔️ Way more fun than riding alone

We start with a quick safety briefing and riding lesson, then head out with a professional guide leading the way.

Jet Ski Rental Options

Choose the ride that fits your vibe:

  • ⏱️ 1 Hour Ride (Quick adrenaline rush)
  • ⏱️ 2 Hour Adventure (Most popular)
  • ⏱️ 3 Hour Island Tour (Best experience)

💡 Pro tip: Longer rides give you time to reach islands + see dolphins.

What’s Included

When you book your St Pete Beach jet ski rental, you get:

✔️ Top-of-the-line jet skis
✔️ Safety equipment & instruction
✔️ Guided tour experience
✔️ Access to top locations
✔️ Optional video package available

Who Can Ride?

  • Drivers must meet Florida boating requirements
  • Passengers allowed (great for couples & families)
  • No experience needed

Not sure about licensing? We’ll guide you through it.

Best Time for Jet Ski Rentals on St Pete Beach

For the best experience:

  • ☀️ Morning = calmer water
  • 🌊 Midday = warmer temps
  • 📅 Weekdays = less crowded

Peak times (book early):
Spring break, weekends, holidays

Book Your St Pete Beach Jet Ski Rental Today

Spots fill quickly — especially during peak season.

👉 Reserve your ride now
👉 Same-day bookings available when open

Experience why we’re one of the top-rated jet ski rentals near St Pete Beach.

Service Areas

We serve riders from:

  • St Pete Beach
  • St Petersburg
  • Treasure Island
  • Madeira Beach
  • Clearwater Beach

Why Choose Xtreme Jetski Watersports?

We’ve built our company around one goal:
👉 Deliver the best jet ski experience in the Tampa Bay area

From safety to equipment to guided routes — everything is dialed in.

That’s why customers consistently rate us 5 stars.

🔥 FAQ SECTION (FOR RANKING + RICH SNIPPETS)

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need experience to rent a jet ski?

No — our guided tours are beginner-friendly and include instruction.

Can I ride a jet ski at St Pete Beach?

Yes, but guided tours offer the best experience and access to better riding areas.

Will I see dolphins?

Very likely — dolphin sightings are common on our tours.

How old do you have to be to drive?

Florida law applies. Contact us if you’re unsure — we’ll help you get set up.

Where do we meet?

We are located just minutes from St Pete Beach with easy access and parking.
